learning_outcomes.text: Students who successfully complete this course will be able to define the concept of evolution and explain the basic mechanisms effective in the evolution of populations.
Students who successfully complete this course will be able to interpret the ecological and genetic factors that lead to evolutionary change.
Students who successfully complete this course will be able to explain evolutionary relationships according to the concepts of common ancestors and derived characters.
Students who successfully complete this course will be able to explain the evolutionary mechanisms effective in the evolution of pathogens.
Students who successfully complete this course will be able to interpret the relationship between evolutionary biology and the emergence of social behavior.
Students who successfully complete this course will be able to explain the relationship between aging and human health and evolution.
Students who successfully complete this course will be able to research current literature and discuss scientifically the experimental study of evolution.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Evolution and Molecular Ecology
Aging and Other Life History Traits
